profile.reasoning: Viktor Silva is a former Senior Manager of Supply Chain Optimization at Amazon, where he spent 8 years building and scaling logistics networks. He specialized in utilizing machine learning to predict demand and optimize delivery routes, significantly reducing costs and improving delivery times. He left Amazon six months ago to found 'FlowState Logistics,' a startup focused on providing AI-powered, hyper-localized delivery solutions for small and medium-sized businesses. He's currently in seed funding, having bootstrapped the initial MVP and secured a small angel investment. He's looking for connections to potential investors, strategic partners in the last-mile delivery space, and experienced advisors who've successfully scaled logistics startups. He’s very data-driven and appreciates direct, concise communication. He's a bit of a 'roll up your sleeves' type, valuing action over endless meetings.
profile.positioning: As Founder & CEO of FlowState Logistics, I'm tackling the significant inefficiencies plaguing last-mile delivery for SMBs. We’re building a platform that leverages cutting-edge AI and hyperlocal logistics networks to provide a cost-effective, reliable, and transparent delivery experience. My background at Amazon, specifically within Supply Chain Optimization, equipped me with a deep understanding of scalable logistics infrastructure and predictive analytics. We identified a clear gap in the market: existing solutions are often geared towards enterprise-level clients, leaving smaller businesses underserved and facing exorbitant delivery costs. FlowState Logistics addresses this by dynamically optimizing delivery routes based on real-time demand, traffic patterns, and courier availability. We’ve already demonstrated a 20% cost reduction in pilot programs with local retailers. Currently, we are closing our seed round to expand our network and refine our AI algorithms. We're not just building a delivery service; we’re building the future of efficient, accessible logistics for everyone.
